title: Introduce latent-token telemetry and quiet-mode alert scheduler
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: Long-tail token emission jitter and delayed segment flushes were invisible to existing token metrics, causing noisy burst alerts and slow RCA during incidents. This PR adds a lightweight "latent-token" telemetry stream and a configurable quiet-mode alert scheduler that can suppress transient burst alerts for high-frequency clients.

What I changed: Added a new metric token_emit_delay_ms (histogram + summary), per-invocation token-phase labels (init, steady, tail), and a tenant-level token-latency-fingerprint. Instrumented the serving runtime to emit lightweight span annotations when token emission stalls > 5ms, and added a new ingestion path that tags traces with token-fingerprint for downstream rollups. Implemented a quiet-mode alert_scheduler service that can be configured per-tenant or per-route; scheduler supports exponential backoff windows, max-suppressions, and an audit log for suppressed alerts.

Checklist:
- [x] Runtime telemetry hooks (serving/runtime/emit_delay)
- [x] Ingestion pipeline: latent-token topic + deduper
- [x] Trace enrichment and tagging (observability/enricher)
- [x] Quiet-mode scheduler service + feature flag
- [x] Dashboard panels and explainer docs
- [x] Unit tests for scheduler logic
- [x] Integration test replaying synthetic bursts

Backward compatibility: telemetry is opt-in via config flags; scheduler defaults to pass-through behavior. No breaking API changes.

Notes on performance: emitting token_emit_delay_ms is low-overhead (sampling 1% by default) and uses reservoir sketches for histograms to keep memory bounded. Added an autosampler to increase sampling when tail anomalies are detected.

How to validate: see README additions under observability/latent-token.md and the new Grafana dashboard snapshot (dashboards/latent-token-trellis.json). To reproduce locally run the synthetic-burst replay tool in tools/replaybench with --latency-jitter.

Related: builds on ideas from ENG-2598 (burst quiet windows) and complements per-route SLO rolling introduced in ENG-3471.
